capabilities: group ribbon icons into named sections with dividers
hide ribbon icons across desktop, tablet and phone
create quick menus that launch command lists from ribbon icons
reorder and hide status bar items by drag and drop
rewrite status bar text with icons and colors
extras: Full documentation lives in an external user guide; the README states the plugin makes no network access and no telemetry, and beta builds are installable via BRAT (xooooooooox/obsidian-ribbon-organizer).
intentEvidence: one eye toggle writes both Obsidian's native hide and Commander's hide list
problem: Obsidian's left ribbon and status bar cannot be grouped, freely reordered, or cleaned up with compact display, especially across desktop and mobile.

relations.evidence: writes both Obsidian's native hide and Commander's hide list
editable labels and icons (Iconize packs included)

summary: Ribbon and status bar manager that groups ribbon icons into named sections, hides them, adds quick command menus, and reorders or rewrites status bar items.
